page.layout: One column of text on the left, with a marginal note on the right beside the line "maxima DAMMONA est". Running head at top, page number at top right. Signature "B" at the lower left below the column, catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: septentrionibus alluit, quâ Amasus, quâ Dullartus se sinuant, in orâ aggeribus perpetuis, opere difficillimo, sepitur & defenditur contra aquarum influxum: idemque, ut dixi jam ante, secundùm Hunesi lapsum fit non ab urbe solùm, sed & supra urbem, usque ad ejusdem ostium. In eâ post Groningam nobilissima & maxima DAMMONA est, non vilis oppidi instar, si ambitum, & frequentiam habitatorum, si ædificiorum numerum, magnitudinem, formam, si viarum habitum spectes, sed honore moenium, & jure imperii civilis magistratuumque carens, amœna, in circulum feré se colligens, fosaque utplurimùm cingens, tem-plo illustri cum turre latè spectabili insig-nis; fanum quoque monasticum peram-plum, sed extra ambitum, lateri tamen occiduo penè contiguum habens familiæ Augustinianæ, nunc ab omni cultu de-sertum, ac vix se sustinens: sita ad Fi-velam amnem duobus infra Groningam milliaribus cæciam versùs, eodemque amne navigabili media divisa, pontibus intus connexa quinque; unde ad exitum

page.notes: Marginal note at right, beside "maxima DAMMONA est": "DAMMONA." Printed in small capitals with spacing, rendered here without spaces. The word "fosaque" is printed as "fosaque" and is kept as printed. Catchword "amnis," appears at the lower right. It is not repeated in the text. "Deque Vrbe Groninga." is the running head with the number 17 at top right. The page number is taken as "17". The text is in one paragraph continued from the previous page, and it runs on to the page end without a new paragraph.
